meta.title: Personalized Holistic Yoga Assessment
meta.description: A comprehensive initial home consultation and custom posture evaluation followed by a tailored 60-minute practice designed around your lifestyle.

meta.title: Couple & Family Home Yoga
meta.description: A shared interactive yoga session tailored for two or more family members to practice together, fostering bonding, balance, and shared vitality.

meta.title: Stress & Relaxation Yoga
meta.description: Deep restorative poses combined with calming pranayama to release nervous system tension and promote restful sleep after long work hours.
meta.ogImageAlt: Practitioner resting deeply in a restorative yoga pose with supportive cushions.

meta.title: Senior Citizen Yoga Practice
meta.description: A safe, slow-paced session focusing on joint mobility, balance, and gentle restorative breathing modified for older adults in their own living room.
meta.ogImageAlt: Senior adult receiving gentle guidance during a personalized home yoga session.

meta.title: Beginner Gentle Yoga Session
meta.description: A patient, step-by-step introduction to foundational postures and breathing exercises. Ideal for anyone beginning their wellness journey in total comfort.
meta.ogImageAlt: Beginner practitioner practicing mindful breathing exercises on a comfortable mat.

meta.title: Back, Neck & Mobility Support
meta.description: Targeted gentle stretches and spinal alignment techniques created specifically to relieve desk fatigue, neck tightness, and lower back discomfort.
meta.ogImageAlt: Yoga instructor assisting client with gentle spinal alignment and posture relief.

meta.title: Weight Management Yoga Support
meta.description: An invigorating flow combining energetic vinyasa movement and mindful breathwork to boost metabolic health and build lean endurance at home.
meta.ogImageAlt: Woman practicing active yoga flow for weight management at home.

meta.title: Fitness & Flexibility Yoga Session
meta.description: A dynamic 1-on-1 home session tailored to deepen your range of motion, build core stamina, and revitalize your energy levels. Designed around your daily routine and fitness goals.
meta.ogImageAlt: Personal yoga instructor guiding flexibility posture in a sunlit living room.
